It's stupid, it's fun, it's stupid fun. Usually like giving a bulky number of hours before reviews but this is a keeper, do not regret waiting for a promo for this one.

It's extremly well optmized with very servicible graphics. My gpu is exactly the one in minimum recommended and this runs smooth like melted butter. I like playing in 1080p and don't care for AA even if games run well on it. Checked once in a while and has not chugged more than 800MB in processes so far.

I'm in love, simple old school gameplay with lots of action and some loot for the mild power fantasy trip of rpg progression (there are no skills trees though, just clarifying)


370+ hours edit: It's so unfair. This series has a stigma that by this title forward should not exist.
It's unfair when people say "it's so bad it's good. It's good, it's a great game! You can fittingly describe it as having a "B movie vibe" if you want but not "bad", that's poppycock.

Another very bad word to describe it: "mindless". You can play it mindlessly but those people also tend to describe later missions as frustrating. Maybe pay attention when NPCs 'mindlessly' say "The most important thing for a soldier is the brain". The game's missions alongside the radio chatter are it's narrative and it's beautiful, you get great cadence in missions with ups and downs that you not only play with but can shape and determine depending on how you decide to go about it regarding tactics.

And even mechanically, it allows you to do so many and such fun things that only require imagination. I'm going to give just an example of something stupid, that encapsulates the "it's not stupid if it works!" motto and what I just mentioned:
- The bikes can be very tricky, dangerous and even feel pointless to use at times. An enemy type called "shield bearer" creates a bubble of invincibility for it's allies, that can still shoot outwards, at you and your allies. Getting inside can be very dangerous. Now picture this ridiculous scenario that seems out of a DnD session: get your bike, plant the strongest sticky explosives you have on it and plant ALL of them. Drive in the direction of the shield bearer at high velocity, exit vehicle, watch it keep going and inside the bubble. Open your emote wheel and pick "EDF EDF" and "AHAHAHAHA" as you probably picked those. Right click your explosives and watch the glory, wipe the tears of joy. That's right, jihad-bike.

Fun to solo on normal but you really need to play it with friends on higher difficulties to get the full experience. Huge amount of weapons but only 120 missions which really sucks because it's such a ride.

Great arcade game. Love the silly b-movie feel to it. great weapons an
d even better with friends.
